name: a layer that draws a geometry
text:
gismodel
geojsonstyle thin fillColor "#fff" strokeColor "#000" fillOpacity 0.5 strokeOpacity 1.0 radius 2.0
geojsonlayer roads entity Road defaultStyle thin availableStyles thin

name: a layer cannot draw a property that is not a geometry
text:
gismodel
geojsonstyle thin fillColor "#fff" strokeColor "#000" fillOpacity 0.5 strokeOpacity 1.0 radius 2.0
geojsonlayer roads entity Road defaultStyle thin availableStyles thin

errors: is a String, not a geometry

name: the default style must be one of the available styles
text:
gismodel
geojsonstyle thin fillColor "#fff" strokeColor "#000" fillOpacity 0.5 strokeOpacity 1.0 radius 2.0
geojsonstyle wide fillColor "#fff" strokeColor "#000" fillOpacity 0.5 strokeOpacity 1.0 radius 4.0
geojsonlayer roads entity Road defaultStyle thin availableStyles wide

errors: defaultStyle 'thin' must be one of availableStyles

name: two layers of a map at the same order warn
text:
gismodel
geojsonstyle thin fillColor "#fff" strokeColor "#000" fillOpacity 0.5 strokeOpacity 1.0 radius 2.0
geojsonlayer roads entity Road defaultStyle thin availableStyles thin
geojsonlayer roads2 entity Road defaultStyle thin availableStyles thin
map main center 40.4 -3.7 zoom 12 {
  use roads style thin selected order 1
  use roads2 style thin selected order 1
}

warnings: order 1 is used twice in map 'main'
